answer: Time-locked attention ledger. Each identity must persistently answer unpredictable micro-tasks whose timing follows a hidden daily tide; missing windows resets accumulated credit. A slow wander across day cycles is fine, but automation must watch continuously, and each parallel identity needs separate sustained human attention. An opal-tier reputation unlocks only after weeks of uninterrupted presence. Duplicating identities multiplies the surveillance and staffing cost linearly, making mass sybils economically irrational.
